name: Solar‑Eclipse Butterfly Migration
description: A sky filled with butterflies whose wings are solar eclipse phases, forming a living corona as they swarm.
prompt: Vast sky during a solar eclipse. Millions of butterflies fill the air; each butterfly's wings display a different phase of the eclipse — from full sun to totality. As they flock, they create a living, moving corona around the darkened sun. Dramatic lighting, high contrast, surreal yet photorealistic, sense of motion.
caption: Wings that wear the eclipse 🦋🌑 #EclipseButterflies
